fusions.name: Venom Flick
fusions.desc: A quick lash that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Constrict
fusions.desc: Wraps the target in a tightening grip that deals 16 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Basket Weave
fusions.desc: Sets a coiled totem that stands for 12 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, each strike with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Companion
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. It also leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
